question: During the 2007-2009 bear, what causally observable characteristics distinguished the eventual March 2009 fast recovery from earlier large, convincing rallies that subsequently failed?
scope: GFC within-regime adversarial discovery. No reentry rule fitting.

false_candidate_definition.local_low: lowest broad-panel price in trailing 10 sessions
false_candidate_definition.episode_dedup: retain one launch per rally episode until a new lower local low occurs
false_candidate_definition.false_label: rally subsequently makes a lower low before 2009-03-09

descriptor_families: OFR Funding/Credit/Volatility level and lagged change
principles: Use future path only to label false versus durable examples; every descriptor at candidate offset must use data available through that date.
Do not use eventual trough distance/date as an operational feature.
Do not require moving-average normalization or low VIX.
Do not optimize thresholds in this stage.
Report whether discrimination appears by days 1,2,3,5,7,10,15; early separation is economically preferred.
Preserve per-rally results; do not average away heterogeneous false rallies.
No portfolio CAGR/DD/wealth fitness and no protected banks.
qualification: Current-S&P broad-market panel has survivorship qualification; OFR shifted two business days.
